additional_info.subject: RE: ID0377520-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R5 170001866] Payment Terminal Issue CRM:00643000888
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
The customer has reported that the payment terminal has not been working since August 11, 2024 An error related to the Payment Terminal has been flagged but typically rebooting resolves the issue. According to Worldline, the payment terminal requires replacement. Before confirming feasibility and connections to the payment terminal, we need to check. If the issue persists, the payment terminal will be replaced.
Please provide the MLFB number for the payment terminal.
